## Gates

`just check` runs `ops-check`, `ops-docs check` and `tasks check`. Until the extraction
lands a suite, `just test-fast` and `just test` run the same checks and the justfile
says so; the extraction replaces the two commands. The pre-push hook carries the full
suite; there is no CI.

## Layout

`tasks/` holds the records; `tools/` the vendored ops tooling. Code arrives with the
extraction, which documents it here.

## Rules

- The split design is ops docs/specs/2026-10-03-agent-layer-split-design.md; this
  project's own specs go under docs/specs (no such directory yet) and are the only ones
  identity.toml may list as authority: the vendored ops-docs refuses an untracked path
  there. This prevents a guide that claims an authority its checks cannot read.
